messages.author: 95631fe4d9361a83
messages.subject: Build pbdR without access to IB card
parts:
I am running into an issue when installing pbdR for MPI stack built with IB support but on a node without an IB card. (Our cluster has EDR IB but we have a separate build node that does not, at this point, have an IB card.) I'm using Intel compilers version 15.3 (though I've replicated the error with gcc 5.2) and OpenMPI 1.8.5. The install command that I'm using is pretty simple:

install.packages("/opt/build/SOURCES/pbdMPI_0.2-5.tar.gz", repos=NULL, lib="~/R/lib")

pbdMPI builds, but when the installer tries to test if the package can be loaded, I get a seg fault:

messages.subject: Re: Build pbdR without access to IB card
parts: We have run a bunch of successful large-scale jobs with our OpenMPI stack and have built a lot of applications against it. With that said, I still wouldn't rule out OpenMPI as a problem. So that I can further debug outside of pbdR, could you tell me a little bit about what pbdBASE is trying to do with pbdMPI during installation? I'm talking about this line in the trace:
21 0x00000000000067c0 spmd_initialize()  /tmp/Rtmp9fuFdb/R.INSTALL1f2d75cded0d8/pbdMPI/src/spmd.c:31

Is that just trying to initialize MPI? 

By the way, after submitting this ticket, I did notice the "no-test-load" option mentioned in your documentation here. That of course solved the problem installing pbdMPI; my question is then how to build subsequent pbdR packages that use pbdMPI.
Thanks,
Justin

messages.author: 2bde96eb78567e9f
messages.subject: Re: Build pbdR without access to IB card
parts:
You can use "no-test-load" on all pbdR packages.
The test load is invoked by R for any R package.
Because pbdSLAP needs a gird communicator, so pbdBASE initials it when library is loading.
That 31th line is not the true reason caused you seg. fault.
It is just to initial a communicator which is something called within MPI functions give you trouble at run-time.
e.g. run-time MPI library is different with compiling-time MPI library.

On Thursday, September 3, 2015 at 1:19:23 PM UTC-4, Justin Krometis wrote:
We have run a bunch of successful large-scale jobs with our OpenMPI stack and have built a lot of applications against it. With that said, I still wouldn't rule out OpenMPI as a problem. So that I can further debug outside of pbdR, could you tell me a little bit about what pbdBASE is trying to do with pbdMPI during installation? I'm talking about this line in the trace:

21 0x00000000000067c0 spmd_initialize()  /tmp/Rtmp9fuFdb/R.INSTALL1f2d75cded0d8/pbdMPI/src/spmd.c:31

Is that just trying to initialize MPI? 

By the way, after submitting this ticket, I did notice the "no-test-load" option mentioned in your documentation here. That of course solved the problem installing pbdMPI; my question is then how to build subsequent pbdR packages that use pbdMPI.
Thanks,
Justin
